summary_en: Kokuyo completed acquisition of all shares in Thien Long An Thinh Investment Corporation, indirectly obtaining 46.82% of Thien Long Group Corporation's issued shares. The acquisition follows regulatory approval from Vietnamese authorities. Thien Long Group is expected to become a consolidated subsidiary on January 1, 2027, following approval at the company's extraordinary shareholders' meeting scheduled for December 7, 2026.
title_en: Notice on Completion of Acquisition and Public Tender Offer for Thien Long Group Corporation Subsidiary Status (Stock Acquisition with Change in Specified Subsidiary)
translation_en_brief:
Kokuyo Co., Ltd. announced the completion of its acquisition of all shares in Thien Long An Thinh Investment Corporation (TLAT), a vehicle through which the company indirectly obtained 46.82% of the issued shares of Thien Long Group Corporation (TLG). The acquisition was completed on November 6, 2026, following the receipt of necessary regulatory approvals from Vietnamese authorities. TLAT holds 100% of the issued shares of TLG as originally held by TLG's founders and major shareholders.

Following the completion of the TLAT share acquisition, Kokuyo's shareholding in TLG increased to 45,194,651 shares, representing 46.82% of issued shares. This change occurred due to an increase in TLG's total issued shares resulting from a stock dividend. The voting rights proportion remains unchanged at 46.82%.

The company plans to consolidate TLG as a subsidiary effective January 1, 2027. At TLG's extraordinary shareholders' meeting scheduled for December 7, 2026, shareholders are expected to approve the election of directors nominated by Kokuyo, which will result in Kokuyo nominees holding a majority of TLG's board seats. The impact of the TLAT acquisition on the current fiscal year's consolidated financial results is immaterial. The impact on consolidated financial results for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2027, resulting from the consolidation of TLG will be disclosed when details become available.
